source.source_name: MCA Company Master Data (data.gov.in / OGD API)
source.organization: Ministry of Corporate Affairs (via NIC data.gov.in)
source.attribution: Ministry of Corporate Affairs / data.gov.in (required by GODL-India)

parsing.notes: Two-step: GET /lists?filters[org]=Ministry of Corporate Affairs&filters[title]=company master&api-key=KEY to enumerate the 128 resource ids (records[].index_name), then GET /resource/{id}?api-key=KEY&offset=N&limit=100. Handle BOTH schema variants: 2015 (UPPER field names, SUB_CATEGORY, D-M-YYYY dates) and 2021 (lower field names, company_sub_category, industrial_class, email_addr, latest_year_ar/bs, ISO dates). REDACT email_addr (PII). Prefer the newest snapshot per state.

mapping_rules.tax_id: null — PAN not in open data.
mapping_rules.vat_id: null — India uses GST (GSTIN), not in open data.
mapping_rules.status: company_status normalized (ACTIVE->active, STRIKE OFF->struck_off, AMALGAMATED->amalgamated, UNDER LIQUIDATION->under_liquidation, DORMANT->dormant, CONVERTED TO LLP->converted_to_llp).
mapping_rules.activity_code: CIN industry code (chars 2-6) and/or industrial_class (2021); principal_business_activity is the description.
mapping_rules.financials: NOT available here beyond capital + latest_year_ar/bs filing markers.

live_test_plan.smoke: List MCA resources, fetch one small state (e.g. Mizoram 2021) with a free key, parse 2 records.
live_test_plan.full: Iterate all 128 resources (newest snapshot per state), keyed on CIN; redact email; gate behind env.
